opening: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is an aggressive disease with limited treatment options and poor survival. This study explores how a medically supervised ketogenic diet (MSKD) impacts the gut microbiome and treatment response in patients with newly diagnosed metastatic PDAC receiving gemcitabine, nab-paclitaxel, and cisplatin chemotherapy. As part of a randomized Phase II trial, 32 evaluable patients (median age 65.9 years; 53% male), 16 were randomized to either MSKD or standard diet (SD) combined with chemotherapy. s (median age 65.9 years; 53% male), 16 were randomized to either MSKD or standard diet (SD) combined with chemotherapy.
